items.title: Tank Dell: On track for season debut Week 7
items.text:
Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell (knee) is on track to return from injured reserve to make his season debut in Week 7 versus the Giants, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rashod Bateman: Should be OK after exiting Week 6 loss
items.text:
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Bateman (shoulder) "should be OK" after exiting late in the second quarter of Sunday's 13-10 loss to the Browns, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Could return to practice this week
items.text:
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Jackson (ankle) could "potentially" practice in Week 7 and is still being considered day-to-day, Ryan Mink of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
